upload_sync_request.description: Upload sync request JSON to GitHub /sync/requests/

parameters.github_token: Personal access token with repo permissions

upload_sync_request.implementation:
def upload_sync_request(sync_request: Dict, github_token: str) -> Dict:
    import json
    import base64
    import requests

    # Generate file path
    sync_id = sync_request['sync_id']
    file_path = f'sync/requests/{sync_id}.json'

    # Prepare content
    content = json.dumps(sync_request, indent=2)
    encoded_content = base64.b64encode(content.encode()).decode()

    # GitHub API request
    url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/HVSCMA/hvscma-cmas/contents/{file_path}'
    headers = {
        'Authorization': f'token {github_token}',
        'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'
    }

    payload = {
        'message': f'🔄 New sync request: {sync_request.get("property_address", "Unknown")}',
        'content': encoded_content,
        'branch': 'main'
    }

    response = requests.put(url, headers=headers, json=payload)

    return {
        'success': response.status_code == 201,
        'status_code': response.status_code,
        'file_path': file_path,
        'download_url': response.json().get('content', {}).get('download_url') if response.status_code == 201 else None,
        'error': response.text if response.status_code != 201 else None
    }
error_handling: Rate limit exceeded (403) → Exponential backoff retry
File already exists (422) → Generate new UUID and retry
Authentication failed (401) → Log error and notify user
Network timeout → Retry up to 3 times

parameters.sync_id: UUID of sync request to download

error_handling: File not found (404) → Return structured not found response
Authentication failed (401) → Log and retry with fresh token
Malformed JSON → Log parsing error and move to /failed/

move_sync_file.description: Move sync file between directories (requests → processing → completed)
error_handling: Concurrent modification → Retry with fresh SHA
Target file exists → Generate timestamped filename
Delete failure after create → Log warning, continue

list_sync_files.description: List all files in a sync directory
error_handling: Directory not found (404) → Return empty list
